verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter's NIW page explicitly states "We respond to any requests for evidence at no additional cost," so RFE response work is documented as included rather than limited to clean first filings. Its own fee-transparency guidance also treats RFE coverage as a key question to ask any firm. missing for 10: any mention of NOID responses, detail on how RFE responses are handled, evidence that RFE coverage extends beyond NIW petitions, and independent or client corroboration.
